# services/packs/pages/

## Purpose
Composes the board pack's twelve `PackPage`s from the figure set. `boardPackDocument.ts` fetches; `boardPackPages.ts` (`buildBoardPackPages`) is a synchronous SEQUENCE of per-page composers; `packDocumentAssembly.ts` is its last step (front pages, contents fit, basis page, numbering, `assertPackIntegrity`). `packDocumentWire.ts` is the JSON boundary (`serialisePackPagesDocument` / `adoptPackPagesDocument`).

## Pages and their composers
1 cover, 2 contents: `packFrontMatter` (+ `packContentsFit`, `packUnnumberedPage`). 3 highlights: `packHighlights` + `packHighlightsBlocks`. 4 commentary and actions: `packNarrativePage`, `packNarrativeLayout`. 5 monthly results: `packMonthlyPage` (`packMonthlyResults`, `packMonthlyMeasures`, `packMonthlyCaption`, `packEbitdaMemo`). 6 income: `packIncomeSheet` (+ `packProfitBridge`). 7 position: `packPositionSheet` (+ `packPositionChart`, `packTradeBalances`). 8 cash: `packCashSheet` (+ `packCashBridge`, `packCashTrendChart`). 9 scorecard: `packScorecardSheet`, `packScorecardNotes`, `packScorecard`. 10 trends: `packTrendBlocks`, `packTrendPanelSet`/`packTrendPanelCharts`. 11 matters: `packMattersPage`, `packMattersSelection`, `packMatters`, `packMatterSources`. 12 basis: `packBasisPage`, `packBasis`, `packDefinitions`, `packGlossaryTerms`.

Most files below exist only for the 300-line cap and are re-exported from the original, so imports did not move.
- Blocks: `packHighlightsBlocks`, `packTrendBlocks`, `packTrendScaleNote`, `packBridgeSignFootnote`, `packInWords` (from `packPageBlocks`); `packBlockBuilders` and `packScale` are leaves that break import cycles.
- Charts: `packProfitBridge`, `packCashBridge`, `packPositionChart`, `packChartRungs`, `packWaterfallBars` (from `packPageCharts`); `packTrendPanelSet`, `packTrendPrintedFigures`, `packTrendPanelCharts`, `packCashTrendChart` (from `packTrendCharts`).
- Types: `packKpiTileModel`, `packTableModel`, `packScorecardModel` (from `packBlockModel`).
- Statements: `packStatementRows`, `packTableAnchors` (from `packStatementTables`); `packStatementFootnotes` (from `packBasis`); `packStatementFootnoteAnchors`.
- Page 12: `packGlossaryTerms`, `packEbitdaBridge` (from `packDefinitions`); `packBasisPage`.
- Fit and height: `packOmissionFootnote` (from `packPageFit`); `packDisclosureHeight`, `packKpiTileHeight` (from `packBlockHeights`).
- Composer pieces from `boardPackPages`: `packBoardPackInput`, `packPrintedStrings`, `packScorecardSheet`, `packMattersSelection`, `packPositionSheet`, `packPrintsComparative`, `packNarrativePage`, `packDocumentAssembly`.
- Cross-references and receivables: `packPeriodCounterparts`, `packWindowFootnotes` (from `packTrendCrossReference`); `packReceivablesDecomposition`, `packReceivablesBaseNote` (from `packReceivablesReconciliation`); `packMatterSources` (from `packMatters`); `packScorecardMetrics` (from `packScorecard`).

## Block / height / fit model
- A page is a list of typed blocks (`packBlockModel`) plus footnotes. `packPageMetrics.pageMm` sums block heights (`packBlockHeights`, `packTextMetrics` for text wrapping); `pageBoxMm` is the sheet.
- **The ruler must never under-estimate Chromium.** `WIDTH_SAFETY` and the per-script em table are calibrated against real renders (`tests/unit/print/packTextMetrics.test.ts`, `packSheetCount.test.ts`). Loosening either needs those green.
- **A page that does not fit drops prose and says so; it never starts a thirteenth sheet.** `fitPageToBox` trims optional notes, then footnotes, then the trailing notes of a REQUIRED disclosure (`PackDisclosure.required`), then truncates the longest note. Nothing carrying a figure is trimmed. A required note that cannot fit throws a `PackRefusal`. Omissions are stated in a page footnote.
- Charts step down ONE rung (`packChartRungs`) before prose goes; a chart that already drew its measured height (`...AtHeight`) is preferred over a rung. Page 7's composition chart never goes below `POSITION_CHART_FLOOR_MM`.
- Page 11 spends its own budget first (`mattersBudgetMm`, `packMattersPrinted`); a matter with no rand amount is always kept. Pages 4 and 11 read ONE `SelectedMatters`.

## Rules for composing pages
- A bridge's tick count comes from its plot's height wherever it is drawn with a box — every board-pack bridge, and the management pack's (`legacyWaterfallOption`, 320px, measured in the screen's Plex Mono via `monospaceMeasure`): the ask targets `TICK_PITCH_PX` (26px a step — `intervalsFor`; `tickIntervals` does the same for `packPositionChart`), and what is enforced is the 18px legibility floor (`MIN_TICK_PITCH_PX`): `waterfallLayout` lowers the ask until no two drawn ticks are closer, and a plot under 36px draws one step, its two ends, by an explicit `interval`. `waterfallOption` called without a box leaves the count to ECharts.
- `kpiTileHeight` charges the delta line for the text the tile prints, wrapped at `KPI_DELTA_MEASURE_MM` (38mm), calibrated on 28 lines rendered through Chromium and pinned in `packKpiTileDeltaHeight.test.ts`. Re-render before changing the tile's wording, its basis or the formatter.
- Every printed money/percentage figure is a `PackFigure` recorded in the provenance map with a unique source; one source printed twice must print the same value.
- Prose claims about another page are derived from what that page drew (`packTrendCrossReference`, `packWindowFootnotes`, `packDisownedBases`, `packPrintsComparative`); never hard-code a pointer or an enumeration. Lists of checks render from `MATTER_SOURCES`.
- A sentence that states a relation takes its result as an input (`narrative/statedRelation.ts`).
- `anchorRow`/`anchorColumn` throw when nothing matches: a footnote with no anchor is a defect.
- Render each chart SVG at `svgBoxFor`'s plot box and pass that same measure to the stylesheet (`--pack-chart-plot-mm`); an SVG whose viewBox mismatches its box is letterboxed (`preserveAspectRatio` meet) and the chart silently shrinks.
- Tables on one page share one column grid (`packScorecardColumns`, `packMattersColumns`).
- Draft status comes only from `packDraftState`; a part month is marked only through `packPartialMonth`; the comparative label comes from `comparativePeriod` via `packPeriodLabel`, never re-formatted.
- A bridge that foots to the cent draws no plug bar; compare floats with `MONEY_TOLERANCE`. A mid-statement subtotal bar is `kind: 'subtotal'`.
- Import cycles here fail at first call, not at compile time (an undefined `SOURCES`); keep the leaves leaves.
